title: The dynamics in health-related quality of life of patients with stable coronary artery disease were revealed: a network analysis
limitations:
- Networks are exploratory, not confirmatory; edges may not represent true causality
- Centrality measures at temporal level may not align with contemporaneous level
- Item selection based on reliability may lead to inflated centrality due to content overlap or high intercorrelation
- Patient-level networks are idiosyncratic and not generalizable
- Time lags between beeps varied, which may affect network structure
- Multilevel VAR assumes all individuals’ parameters originate from the same distribution, which may not be realistic
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are publicly available. Preregistration status is not mentioned in the paper. Supplementary materials are available via DOI but do not confirm code/data availability.
